_comment_allowed_kinds: Omit allowed_kinds to accept every kind the app uses (config.DefaultAllowedKinds). Set an explicit list ONLY to restrict a deployment.

Set enroll_pow to match whatever the organizer/client actually mine (12 for the shipped app).
